aboutSubheading: Local joinery experts you can trust
aboutText: Based at 4-6 Kurnai Ave in Reservoir, Sherwood has been crafting custom cabinetry and joinery for homes and businesses. We take pride in translating designs into premium finished products, as seen in our display suites. Clients can visit our factory to see the craftsmanship firsthand, ensuring every detail aligns with their vision. With efficient production, we deliver high-quality joinery within tight timelines.
servicesText: Sherwood offers a full range of cabinet making services, from initial design consultation to final installation. We specialise in custom joinery for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces, using high-quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry
services.desc: We design and build bespoke cabinets tailored to your specific needs, ensuring perfect fit and finish for any room.

services.title: Kitchen Joinery
services.desc: From modern to traditional styles, we create kitchen cabinetry that combines functionality with aesthetic appeal.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Our custom vanities are crafted to maximise space and style, using moisture-resistant materials for durability.

services.title: Built-in Wardrobes
services.desc: Maximise storage with our built-in wardrobes, designed to seamlessly integrate with your bedroom decor.

services.title: Commercial Fit-outs
services.desc: We provide high-quality joinery for offices, retail spaces, and other commercial environments in Reservoir.

services.title: Design Consultation
services.desc: Our experts work with you from the start, interpreting drawings and refining details to achieve your vision.
